$comment: Per-table silent-failure reminders injected by sn-artifact-skill-reminder.js at write time. FRAMEWORK entries below are verified platform truth — extend (don't edit) with customer-discovered entries during the engagement; each entry names the owning skill so the agent loads it.
sys_script_client: client-scripts skill — onChange REQUIRES the `field` column (NOT field_name/fieldname) or it NEVER fires; ui_type="10" for workspace; every getMessage key must be listed in the `messages` field.
sys_ui_policy_action: ui-actions-policies skill — create_artifact/update_record CANNOT set the `ui_policy` reference (silent fail -> orphaned action, no effect). Create the policy AND its actions together via run_background_script.
sys_ui_policy: ui-actions-policies skill — ui_type="10"; set on_load / reverse_if_false deliberately; the action link on sys_ui_policy_action can only be set via a background script.
sys_ui_action: ui-actions-policies / workspace-modal-actions skill — workspace buttons need form_button_v2="true"; put client logic in client_script_v2 (not script/onclick).
sys_script: business-rule-patterns skill — the filter is the gatekeeper; a filter term that dot-walks a BASE-table reference into a child-table-only field silently matches 0 rows -> check such conditions in-script; verify the filter matches >0 intended rows; ES5 only in global scope.
sys_script_include: script-include-patterns skill — scoped Ajax MUST extend global.AbstractAjaxProcessor; client GlideAjax MUST use the full api_name (e.g. <your_scope>.MyAjax); match the scope's ES level.
contract_sla: sla-management skill — duration_type must reference a valid cmn_relative_duration; verify start/stop conditions + schedule with a query after create.
